item.summary: Union Minister of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (MoPSW), Sarbananda Sonowal inaugurated the corporate office of Sagarmala Finance Corporation Limited (SMFCL) at the Institute for Studies in Industrial Development (ISID) in New Delhi today, giving a permanent home to what he called India's first dedicated Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC) in the maritime sector.
item.title: India's First Maritime NBFC SMFCL Scales up with Rs 5,107 Crs Disbursed, Aims for Rs 60,205 Crs by 2031
